recette.accroche: How well do you know your partner?
recette.consigne: 8 questions, 5 seconds each. Count your right answers!
questions: What makes your partner feel better after a bad day?
What do they watch when they are sick?
What color is their favorite blanket?
Hug, space or talk: what do they need?

fin.question: How many did you get? Comment your score!

en.legende:
Comfort edition: 8 questions about what makes your partner feel better. Cozy knowledge counts!

Comment your score!
